reviews.author: Hannah M.
reviews.text: Finally found a colourist in SW7 who listens. My balayage grows out so softly and the salon feels like a quiet sanctuary.

reviews.author: Priya S.
reviews.text: Best BIAB manicure and blow-dry in Kensington. Warm welcome, honest pricing and my nails still look immaculate three weeks on.

reviews.author: Claire T.
reviews.text: Complimentary colour consultation gave me total confidence before booking. Could not recommend the team more highly.

about: Linden & Silk is an independent hair and beauty studio in South Kensington designed to feel calm, bright and unhurried. Our senior stylists and therapists use ammonia-free colour, vegan bond builders and gentle skincare — with complimentary 15-minute consultations before any colour booking.
